operations.reason: ENROLLMENT/TLS/SECRET BOOTSTRAP. Carries TLS CA/cert/KEY and one-time enrollment secrets; intentionally operator-only.
operations.equivalentFlow: Known-node status via PingNode/GetNode; provisioning and credential rotation are operator actions.

operations.scope: session authentication; servers/read[server_id] for subscribers and servers/command[server_id] for commands
operations.reason: PRIVATE BROWSER↔PANEL HANDSHAKE. /ws is a console/log/event hub; WebSocket upgrade is explicitly refused by the renderer proxy.
operations.equivalentFlow: WorldViewService/GetWorldViewStatus (pollable status) and ActivityService/ListActivityLogs via typed RPCs.

operations.reason: BROWSER IdP HANDSHAKE. OIDC login is a browser redirect flow, not a Connect RPC or an MCP credential flow.
operations.equivalentFlow: Agent uses a dp_ Bearer token; browser users use the panel UI.

operations.scope: public OIDC callback with signed state
operations.reason: BROWSER IdP CALLBACK. Redirects to /login?code=<one-time-code>; not an agent surface.
operations.equivalentFlow: Agent uses a dp_ Bearer token; browser users use the panel UI.

operations.reason: ONE-TIME CODE → SESSION TOKEN EXCHANGE. Redeems a single-use, IP-bound, TTL-60s code and returns the browser session token with Cache-Control: no-store; a session token is not an MCP credential.
operations.equivalentFlow: Agent uses a dp_ Bearer token provisioned out of band; never redeems browser codes.

operations.reason: UNAUTHENTICATED LIVENESS PROBE. Public, read-only, no ACL evidence.
operations.equivalentFlow: ServerService/GetServer and NodeService/PingNode (ACL-scoped status).

operations.reason: UNAUTHENTICATED READINESS PROBE. Public, read-only, no ACL evidence.
operations.equivalentFlow: ServerService/GetServer and NodeService/PingNode (ACL-scoped status).

operations.reason: UNAUTHENTICATED DETAILED HEALTH PROBE. Public, read-only, no ACL evidence.
operations.equivalentFlow: ServerService/GetServer, GetServerLogs and NodeService/PingNode (ACL-scoped).

operations.reason: PRIVATE WORKER/STREAMING JSONL PROTOCOL. Internal transport between controller and storage worker, not a product API.
operations.equivalentFlow: FileService/GetFile, SaveUploadedFile and WorldService/ExportWorld over typed RPCs.

operations.reason: PRIVATE CARBON-STORAGE SUBPROCESS TRANSPORT. ProcessTransport is internal node storage plumbing.
operations.equivalentFlow: FileService and WorldService typed RPCs; node status via PingNode.

operations.reason: PRIVATE WORLD BLOB STORE. Internal content-addressed storage, not an agent API.
operations.equivalentFlow: WorldService revision/import RPCs and FileService/ExportWorld.

operations.reason: PRIVATE DOCKER NODE-CONTROL TRANSPORT. Connection pool to node Docker daemons; never exposed as a tool.
operations.equivalentFlow: ServerService lifecycle RPCs and NodeService/PingNode.

operations.reason: CLI-ONLY OPERATOR MAINTENANCE (list, ports, release-port, resolve). Runs offline before server start; not reachable over MCP.
operations.equivalentFlow: OperationService/ListOperations, GetOperation and ResolveOperation RPCs for the UI-facing equivalent.

operations.reason: CLI-ONLY MAINTENANCE MODE including offline DB restore; exits before serving, no MCP path.
operations.equivalentFlow: Supported RPCs cover the in-service equivalents; offline DB restore has no agent equivalent.

operations.reason: INTERNAL RECONCILER NUDGE triggered by operator maintenance flags, not a product operation.
operations.equivalentFlow: OperationService/ResolveOperation for operator-visible lock release.

operations.reason: PUBLIC DISCOVERY: reflection describes the registered Connect services and is outside the MCP product-data catalogue.
operations.equivalentFlow: Use tools/list for callable product tools. The controller reflection service describes the registered RPC contracts.

operations.reason: PUBLIC OPENAPI SPEC. Documentation, not an agent tool.
operations.equivalentFlow: Typed tool schemas in the MCP catalog.

operations.reason: STATIC SVELTEKIT FRONTEND CATCH-ALL. Browser assets only.
operations.equivalentFlow: Typed RPC tools.

operations.scope: uploads/create[*] for PUT; files/create[server_id] for typed commit
operations.reason: BYTE-TRANSPORT ENDPOINT (PUT /api/v1/upload/{sessionId}). Represented in MCP by the composed typed upload path (rest_upload_stream_commit): a bounded session handle and bounded chunks, owner-bound and confirm-gated, never a raw or unbounded byte stream.
operations.equivalentFlow: Mapped through the composed workflow: UploadService/InitUpload + UploadChunk -> FileService/SaveUploadedFile (bounded, server-relative path).

operations.reason: BYTE-TRANSPORT ENDPOINT (GET /api/v1/download/{sessionId}). Authz fail-closed (files/read[server_id]); represented by the download_stream composed tool with a bounded session id and 8 MiB admission bound, never a raw or unbounded byte stream or a gateway filesystem path.
operations.equivalentFlow: Mapped through the composed workflow: FileService/GetFile (bounded) or InitFileDownload + DownloadArchive.

operations.reason: EXCLUDED: provider credentials and third-party egress. The REST adapter and ConfigService/ValidateProviderKey share the same operation and settings/read policy.
operations.equivalentFlow: Validate provider credentials out of band using the panel's authorized settings workflow.

operations.scope: mods/read[server_id] or mods/create[server_id]; global object for server_id=none
operations.reason: DEPRECATED LEGACY REST MOD ADAPTER. Fail-closed shared policy but superseded by the generated browse contract.
operations.equivalentFlow: ModBrowseService/SearchMods, GetModVersions and InstallMods.

operations.scope: modpacks/read[*] or modpacks/create[*]; public loader catalogue and runtime files
operations.reason: Mixed Studio adapter covering inventory reads, update checks, mutations, multipart import, raw pack files and exports. Only inventory reads have typed MCP equivalents in this slice.
operations.equivalentFlow: Use packwiz_list_packs and packwiz_get_pack for inventory reads. Use Modpack Studio for other operations.

operations.scope: server_config/read[server_id] or server_config/create[server_id]; record owner checked on mutations
operations.reason: EXCLUDED: the legacy adapter and StagedConfigService share the staged-change list, stage, apply, rollback and discard operations. The generated service carries the same server scope and reauthorizes the recorded owner on apply, rollback and discard.
operations.equivalentFlow: MCP list_staged_config_changes returns rollout metadata. Use the panel staged changes workflow for configuration diffs and mutations.

operations.scope: servers/read[*] for host; servers/read[server_id] for a server
operations.reason: EXCLUDED: the host and per-server endpoints expose Prometheus snapshots for monitoring under separate global and server scopes.
operations.equivalentFlow: Use the controller's authenticated Prometheus scrape for monitoring. MCP get_server returns the latest cached operational metrics and player observations for one authorized server.

operations.reason: BROWSER ASSET CHANNEL. Same-origin reverse proxy to a node-local renderer: GET/HEAD only, WebSocket upgrade refused, cp_session cookie + opaque per-user key + world_view/read[server_id] fail-closed. Binary content, not a product-data API or tool.
operations.equivalentFlow: WorldViewService RPCs: GetWorldViewSession (opaque per-user key), GetWorldViewStatus, ListCapabilities and ListMapOverlays.

operations.reason: Page through persisted Studio pack summaries under the global modpacks/read grant.
Read pack metadata and page through its content under global modpacks/read. The gateway omits URLs, paths and raw options.
Outside the current MCP read contract. Cloning can copy an entire pack tree and its persisted assets. An MCP workflow needs a copy budget, collision checks and explicit confirmation.
operations.equivalentFlow: Use Modpack Studio with its existing authorization.

operations.reason: Outside the current MCP read contract. Reindexing changes pack metadata and can rehash the content tree. An MCP workflow needs an explicit confirmation and bounded refresh work.
operations.equivalentFlow: Use Modpack Studio with its existing authorization.

operations.reason: Outside the current MCP read contract. Provider requests fan out across the full pack before the kind filter. An MCP workflow needs request and duration budgets plus a redacted response that omits download URLs and raw changelogs.
operations.equivalentFlow: Use Modpack Studio with its existing authorization.

operations.reason: Outside the current MCP read contract. Deleting a pack recursively removes its authored content. An MCP workflow needs exact-target confirmation and evidence for dependent deployments and removal.
